items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: we had been playing it with Gene Cooper made.

ctx.x: And then he played around here with Sidney's. Band. And he went on the boat. And then he came back. And then he got to play in my band. And he stayed with me quite a while. And he went to... To Ohio. And he went on a job that he... Our whole band was supposed to go on this job. And Miss... Gwendolyn... Gwendolyn... She promoted this job. And it was in Toledo. And finally, I got the show together for her. And she booked the show. And the show went over there. So we was waiting on a telegram for the band. And we…

And Margaret called my name, and I had a big trailer with the name on it, too, right in front of the house. And she said, oh, is that Joe Rova's show? And Margaret said, yeah, that's Joe Rova. And she said, oh, a telegram come here a couple of days ago, and I told her, man, there was nobody here by that name. So when we called up the telegram office, and they stated, they read the telegram out. And so finally, the same day that I was going to pull off to the plate, that's the same day I was supposed to be in…
In Cuba? I didn't know you went to Cuba.
